answer: A beacon marks a milestone thread: each identity locks 70 credits and files a vertex, a key-signed milestone claim linked to the last vertex on the thread. Each epoch the beacon draws one vertex from the thread at random; its owner shows the work in an hour for audit. A copied or rented vertex burns the 70 bond. The k-th milestone costs 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 vs a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 40 once, bond back in one clean epoch.
